newsitem.title: ITALY: Fiat stock recovers on car incentive news.
newsitem.headline: Fiat stock recovers on car incentive news.

text.p: Fiat shares recovered from earlier lows on the Milan bourse on news the Italian cabinet had aproved a bill to extend a national car buying incentive scheme due to have ended in September.
"An extension of the scheme had been more or less discounted but we need to know more details to correctly evaluate Fiat's share price," one dealer said.
At 1021 GMT, Fiat was just 0.08 percent off at 6,045 lire in volume of over 10 million shares after a morning low of 5,945 lire.
Fiat Auto group car sales have been considerably boosted by the scheme introduced by the government in January giving car owners cash bonuses to scrap cars over 10-years old and buy a new vehicle.
